### What does this PR do?

Upgrade the CUDA 13 dependency stack to `vllm==0.32.0` and the project-wide `transformers==5.16.1` pin, then regenerate `uv.lock`.

vLLM 0.32.0 requires `tokenizers>=0.23.2`, while SGLang 0.5.20 still declares `tokenizers==0.22.2`. Add a project-wide `tokenizers==0.23.2` override, following the existing Transformers override pattern, so every resolution fork remains consistent. Also widen the Transformers support window in `setup.py` and `requirements.txt` to `<5.17` so package metadata accepts the pinned version.

Adapt `AsyncLLM.pause_generation()` to the vLLM 0.32 API while retaining vLLM 0.29 compatibility: 0.32 and newer use `mode="abort"`, while older versions keep `wait_for_inflight_requests=False`. Keep the score-centering top-k coverage test valid for both providers: vLLM 0.29 retains cutoff ties, while 0.32 keeps exactly `top_k` entries.

Adapt the Qwen3.5 monkey patches to both Transformers 5.12 and 5.16. Transformers 5.16 renamed decoder `layer_type` to `block_type` and moved causal-convolution and gated-delta callables from instance attributes to module functions.

This is not a duplicate of [#8072](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8072): that PR targets vLLM 0.30.0 only, whereas this PR targets 0.32.0 and includes the required Transformers 5.16.1, tokenizers 0.23.2, and compatibility changes.

AI assistance was used to update dependency pins, regenerate the lockfile, diagnose CI, implement compatibility handling, run checks, and draft this PR. The submitter reviewed the changed files and confirmed the change.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs. Query: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+vllm+upgrade
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}` (This will be checked by the CI)

### Test

- `uv lock` — resolved 378 packages successfully.
- `uv lock --check` — passed.
- `.venv-vllm/bin/python -m pytest tests/workers/rollout/rollout_vllm/test_submitter_gate_on_cpu.py -q` — 18 passed.
- `.venv-vllm/bin/python -m pytest tests/workers/rollout/rollout_vllm/test_vllm_topk_support.py -q -k 'small_decode_batch_provider_support_coverage or pure_top_p_overflow'` — 5 passed.
- `.venv-vllm/bin/torchrun --nproc_per_node=1 -m pytest tests/special_distributed/test_qwen35_linear_attention_ulysses_sp.py -q` — 2 passed.
- Transformers 5.12.1 compatibility probe — legacy Qwen3.5 decoder and gated-delta instance attributes are detected.
- `uvx --with hydra-core pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure --color=always` — all hooks passed.
- `uvx --with hydra-core pre-commit run --files verl/models/transformers/qwen3_5.py tests/workers/rollout/rollout_vllm/test_vllm_topk_support.py` — all hooks passed after the CI fixes.
- `git diff --check` — passed.

### API and Usage Example

No user-facing API change. Sync the vLLM environment through the existing extra:

`uv sync --extra fsdp --extra vllm`

### Design & Code Changes

- Pin vLLM 0.32.0 and Transformers 5.16.1 across the uv backend extras.
- Override tokenizers at 0.23.2 to satisfy vLLM 0.32.0 and Transformers 5.16.1 while retaining SGLang 0.5.20.
- Expand the package and development Transformers support window from `<5.13` to `<5.17`.
- Select the legacy or current vLLM pause keyword according to `_VLLM_VERSION`, with regression coverage for 0.29.0 and 0.32.0.
- Preserve conservative top-k support evidence across the different vLLM 0.29 and 0.32 cutoff-tie semantics.
- Resolve Qwen3.5 decoder and kernel callables from their Transformers 5.12 instance attributes or Transformers 5.16 module-level replacements.
- Regenerate the universal lockfile for all platform and backend resolution forks.

### What does this PR do?

Upgrade the CUDA 13 dependency stack to `vllm==0.32.0` and the project-wide `transformers==5.16.1` pin, then regenerate `uv.lock`.

vLLM 0.32.0 requires `tokenizers>=0.23.2`, while SGLang 0.5.20 still declares `tokenizers==0.22.2`. Add a project-wide `tokenizers==0.23.2` override, following the existing Transformers override pattern, so every resolution fork remains consistent. Also widen the Transformers support window in `setup.py` and `requirements.txt` to `<5.17` so package metadata accepts the pinned version.

Adapt `AsyncLLM.pause_generation()` to the vLLM 0.32 API while retaining vLLM 0.29 compatibility: 0.32 and newer use `mode="abort"`, while older versions keep `wait_for_inflight_requests=False`. Keep the score-centering top-k coverage test valid for both providers: vLLM 0.29 retains cutoff ties, while 0.32 keeps exactly `top_k` entries.

Adapt the Qwen3.5 monkey patches to both Transformers 5.12 and 5.16. Transformers 5.16 renamed decoder `layer_type` to `block_type` and moved causal-convolution and gated-delta callables from instance attributes to module functions.

This is not a duplicate of [#8072](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8072): that PR targets vLLM 0.30.0 only, whereas this PR targets 0.32.0 and includes the required Transformers 5.16.1, tokenizers 0.23.2, and compatibility changes.

AI assistance was used to update dependency pins, regenerate the lockfile, diagnose CI, implement compatibility handling, run checks, and draft this PR. The submitter reviewed the changed files and confirmed the change.
